data_sources.description: Name, VAT/PAN, address for the To block: the first picked Customer, else the first picked Supplier.
data_sources.query:
SELECT x.party_name, x.tax_id, x.address
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS sort_order, p.customer_name AS party_name, p.tax_id AS tax_id, a.address_line1 AS address
    FROM `tabCustomer` p
        LEFT JOIN `tabAddress` a ON a.name = p.customer_primary_address
    WHERE p.name IN %(party_customers)s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS sort_order, p.supplier_name AS party_name, p.tax_id AS tax_id, a.address_line1 AS address
    FROM `tabSupplier` p
        LEFT JOIN `tabAddress` a ON a.name = p.supplier_primary_address
    WHERE p.name IN %(party_suppliers)s
) x
ORDER BY x.sort_order
LIMIT 1
-- %(party_customers)s / %(party_suppliers)s = plain names of the picked Customers / Suppliers
-- (built from the "Name (Customer)" / "Name (Supplier)" picks, NULL when none picked).

data_sources.description: Opening / closing balance from GL Entry: all picked Customers + Suppliers together (positive = Dr, negative = Cr).
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.posting_date < %(from_date)s
                       OR gle.is_opening = 'Yes'
                      THEN gle.debit - gle.credit END), 0)  AS opening,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                       OR gle.is_opening = 'Yes'
                      THEN gle.debit - gle.credit END), 0)  AS closing
FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
WHERE gle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND gle.company = %(company)s
  AND (
        (gle.party_type = 'Customer' AND gle.party IN %(party_customers)s)
     OR (gle.party_type = 'Supplier' AND gle.party IN %(party_suppliers)s)
  )
-- %(party_customers)s / %(party_suppliers)s = plain names of the picked Customers / Suppliers
-- (built from the "Name (Customer)" / "Name (Supplier)" picks, NULL when none picked).

data_sources.description: Sales, Sales Return (Credit Note, shown positive) and Net from Sales Invoice for all picked Customers.
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 0 THEN inv.base_net_total END), 0)                 AS taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 0 THEN inv.base_total_taxes_and_charges END), 0)   AS vat,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 0 THEN inv.base_grand_total END), 0)               AS total,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 1 THEN inv.base_net_total END), 0)                AS ret_taxable,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 1 THEN inv.base_total_taxes_and_charges END), 0)  AS ret_vat,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN inv.is_return = 1 THEN inv.base_grand_total END), 0)              AS ret_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_net_total), 0)                                                     AS net_taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_total_taxes_and_charges), 0)                                       AS net_vat,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_grand_total), 0)                                                   AS net_total
FROM `tabSales Invoice` inv
WHERE inv.docstatus = 1
  AND inv.company = %(company)s
  AND inv.customer IN %(party_customers)s
  AND inv.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
-- %(party_customers)s / %(party_suppliers)s = plain names of the picked Customers / Suppliers
-- (built from the "Name (Customer)" / "Name (Supplier)" picks, NULL when none picked).

data_sources.description: Purchase, Purchase Return (Debit Note, shown +) and Net from Purchase Invoice for all picked Suppliers.
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 0 THEN x.taxable END), 0)            AS taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 0 THEN x.vat END), 0)                AS vat,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 0 THEN x.taxable + x.vat END), 0)    AS total,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 1 THEN x.taxable END), 0)           AS ret_taxable,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 1 THEN x.vat END), 0)               AS ret_vat,
    COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN x.is_return = 1 THEN x.taxable + x.vat END), 0)   AS ret_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(x.taxable), 0)                                               AS net_taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(x.vat), 0)                                                   AS net_vat,
    COALESCE(SUM(x.taxable + x.vat), 0)                                       AS net_total
FROM (
    SELECT inv.is_return, inv.base_net_total AS taxable, COALESCE(vat.amt, 0) AS vat
    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` inv
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent, SUM(base_tax_amount) AS amt
                   FROM `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges`
                   WHERE account_head LIKE '%%VAT%%' GROUP BY parent) vat ON vat.parent = inv.name
    WHERE inv.docstatus = 1
      AND inv.company = %(company)s
      AND inv.supplier IN %(party_suppliers)s
      AND inv.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) x
-- %(party_customers)s / %(party_suppliers)s = plain names of the picked Customers / Suppliers
-- (built from the "Name (Customer)" / "Name (Supplier)" picks, NULL when none picked).

data_sources.description: Customer name and address

data_sources.description: Estimate item rows
data_sources.query:
SELECT l.sn, l.item_name, l.item_description, l.unit, l.rate, l.qty * l.rate AS amount,
    TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM FORMAT(l.qty, 2, 'en_US'))) AS qty_text
FROM (SELECT 1 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_1)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_1)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_1)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_1)s
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_2)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_2)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_2)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_2)s
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_3)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_3)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_3)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_3)s) l ORDER BY l.sn

data_sources.description: Total, discount, taxable, VAT 13% and grand total
data_sources.query:
SELECT x.total, x.discount, x.total - x.discount AS taxable,
    ROUND((x.total - x.discount) * 0.13, 2) AS vat,
    ROUND((x.total - x.discount) * 1.13, 2) AS grand_total
FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty * l.rate), 0) AS total, COALESCE(%(discount)s, 0) AS discount FROM (SELECT 1 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_1)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_1)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_1)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_1)s
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_2)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_2)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_2)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_2)s
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS sn, i.item_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(description_3)s, ''), NULLIF(i.description, i.item_name), '') AS item_description,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(%(qty_3)s, 0), 1) AS qty, 'Month' AS unit, COALESCE(%(rate_3)s, 0) AS rate
FROM `tabItem` i WHERE i.name = %(item_3)s) l) x

data_sources.description: Period taxable, VAT, TDS and total from Purchase Invoice.
data_sources.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_net_total), 0)   AS taxable,
    COALESCE(SUM(vat.amt), 0)              AS vat,
    COALESCE(SUM(tds.amt), 0)              AS tds,
    COALESCE(SUM(inv.base_grand_total), 0) AS total
FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` inv
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent, SUM(base_tax_amount) AS amt
               FROM `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges`
               WHERE account_head LIKE '%%VAT%%' GROUP BY parent) vat ON vat.parent = inv.name
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent, SUM(base_tax_amount) AS amt
               FROM `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges`
               WHERE account_head LIKE '%%TDS%%' GROUP BY parent) tds ON tds.parent = inv.name
WHERE inv.docstatus = 1
  AND inv.company = %(company)s
  AND inv.supplier = %(supplier)s
  AND inv.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
